decisions.reason: It builds directly on existing candle arch and woodworking craft, so the firm can interpret early results and improve it using established skills.
The arched one-tier pyramid is a variation of core pyramid expertise, allowing the firm to assimilate feedback and refine the design.
Although electronic components lie partly outside traditional craft knowledge, it is a strategic flagship and the firm can leverage its music box assembly and design experience to learn.
The motif platform is a simple wooden accessory that uses existing material and painting capabilities, so early results are easy to interpret and improve.
The Christmas motif platform similarly relies on established wood decoration skills and complements the electronic music box line.
The Dresden theme pyramid builds on proven pyramid construction and painting knowledge, making it a low-risk extension.
